answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with staked identity plus random audit: each agent locks collateral for a signed credential, and every voyage a random committee checks others' attestations. A false vote slashes the offender's bond, honest work earns fees. The draw is unpredictable, so an attacker cannot know which identities get called and must fund every forged account with the same ivory-grade deposit. To sway a third of a quorum they must lock that stake across thousands of wallets, and one caught vote forfeits the whole ocean, making the attack cost more than any honest gain.
